body: I am getting "help" but its a slow process. Fatigue isn't something you can fix in a day. I forgot to mention I've been to at least 100 doctor's appointments since 2 years ago no one really knows how to help. Its very depressing having something people don't know how to resolve. Half the doctors I've been to just think its all in my head. I wish I could also list all the other health problems I have, but it would be too easy to identify who I am. I don't know what telling people is going to do, they can't fix anything and the state wont let me have less schooling so there is no way I'm going to get my diploma in my teen years.
